experiment.title: SCE Experiment 2.5 - Reactive Probe: IMDS Tamper Automated Incident Response Validation
experiment.description: Validates that the reactive controls for SCE node 2.5 execute correctly after attack nodes 1.2 (ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions setting HttpTokens=optional and HopLimit=2, downgrading IMDSv2 to IMDSv1 and enabling container bridge traversal) and 2.2 (ec2:DescribeInstances confirming the weakened IMDS state persists as the attacker precondition for unauthenticated credential retrieval) are executed against a scoped EC2 instance in a clean AWS account. The experiment provisions a VPC, a normal security group (pre-attack), a quarantine security group (post-reactive, no inbound or outbound rules), an SSM Automation document implementing the reactive playbook, and a t3.micro EC2 target instance with IMDSv2 enforced at baseline. All IAM resources (EC2 instance role, instance profile, SSM Automation execution role) are created directly via boto3 before CloudFormation is invoked, eliminating the IAM-in-CFN ValidationError root cause documented across prior detective probe executions. No Description= field is passed to any IAM API call. The attack phase executes both attack nodes and then starts the SSM Automation document to simulate the automated incident response pipeline firing. The reactive probe confirms five independent signals within a 30-minute SLA: (A) the SSM Automation execution reaches Success status confirming the playbook ran to completion, (B) the EC2 instance role has the SCEDenyAllRevocation Deny-all inline policy attached confirming credential revocation (ADT 2.4 CREDENTIAL_COMPROMISE playbook), (C) the instance security groups contain the quarantine SG confirming network isolation (ADT 2.4 EC2_HOST_COMPROMISE playbook), (D) an EBS snapshot tagged with the experiment key exists for the root volume confirming forensic capture (ADT 2.4 snapshot EBS volumes), and (E) the instance is tagged SecurityStatus=IMDS_TAMPER_DETECTED confirming deployment blocking (ADT 1.4). Rollback deletes the EBS snapshot, the CloudFormation stack, and all boto3-created IAM resources including pre-removing the Deny-all revocation policy to allow clean role deletion.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: All five reactive signals confirmed within 30-minute SLA: SSM Automation success, IAM Deny-all revocation, quarantine SG assignment, EBS snapshot creation, and IMDS_TAMPER_DETECTED tag
